en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a river or stream bordered by trees and rough terrain, with one or two small wooden structures or logs in the foreground. A woman in old-fashioned attire is seen sitting beside the water, possibly doing laundry or resting. The back of the postcard is addressed in elegant cursive, uses Swedish text, and features a 5 öre green Swedish stamp with a side-profile portrait. There are hand-written notes and a printed label reading 'BREVKORT. (Carte postale.)', with visible postmarks.
